passives.name: Survival Instinct
passives.description: (Passive Effect) After an enemy acts, if the target is Poisoned, restores [Buff_V_4076003_11_2] WG. At the start of the turn, if Burned, becomes Unhealable for [Buff_T_4076003_11_1] turns. Damage dealt to non-Fire enemies increases, and damage taken decreases. Damage dealt to Fire enemies decreases, and damage taken increases.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
